name: 78108 · Cibolo, TX
findings: ZIP 78108 (Cibolo) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78108 (Cibolo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78108 (Cibolo) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
